blocks.html: The Senior Golfer’s Society of Malaysia, or SGSM in short, is an exclusive society for golfers who are 55 years of age and above. The society, with a history dating back to 1930s, is the nation’s foremost society for veteran golfers, with distinguished members who share a passion for this gentleman’s sport. Although SGSM is based in Kuala Lumpur, membership to the Society is open to all Malaysians.
